topic: How to book 10 calls a day on autopilot

script.title: 10 calls/day on autopilot (no team needed)
script.hook: I haven't booked a call manually in 90 days — here's the system that did it for me.

beats.text: You're posting content, chasing DMs, and still ending the week with 2 calls booked. That's not hustle — that's a broken system.
Empire OS deploys an AI agent that does what your BDR refuses to do — 14 hours a day, no complaints, no excuses.
It finds the lead, warms them up over DM, qualifies the budget, and only drops a call link when intent is hot.
One founder in SaaS booked 11 calls yesterday. Another in coaching closed $14K while he was at the gym.
The pipeline runs whether you're live or not. While you sleep, it's selling.
We only onboard 10 operators this week. After that, the door closes.
Comment 'AUTOPILOT' and we'll DM you the setup.

script.cta: Comment 'AUTOPILOT' — we'll DM you the playbook and lock your spot.
